album.title: Radif Navazi - Tar: Abu Ata, Afshari

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Fk5 and dwells most on D in Yaquluna. The line peaks at D5 (557.2 Hz) at 0:58.6. It closes on D5, not the tonic (G4 → F4 → Ak4 → D5 → D5 → D5).
